title: Dihydromyricetin attenuates cholestatic liver injury by suppressing JAK2/STAT3-associated NF-kappaB inflammatory and apoptotic signaling.
authors: Cheng, Yongkang; Feng, Sansan; Feng, Yahui; Yang, Chunfeng; Sheng, Chuqiao; Li, Yumei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黄酮类化合物DHM对胆汁淤积性肝损伤的保护作用，聚焦JAK2/STAT3-NF-kB信号通路，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系、结合建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Cholestatic liver injury (CLI) is mainly driven by hepatic bile acid accumulation, which promotes hepatocyte injury, inflammation, oxidative stress, and apoptosis. Dihydromyricetin (DHM), a bioactive flavonoid from Ampelopsis grossedentata, has shown hepatoprotective potential, but its role and mechanism in CLI remain unclear. METHODS: Network pharmacology, public transcriptomic analysis, and molecular docking were used to predict candidate targets of DHM in CLI. Taurocholic acid (TCA) treated HepaRG cells and alpha-naphthylisothiocyanate (ANIT)-treated mice were used as in vitro and in vivo models, respectively, with ursodeoxycholic acid (UDCA) included as a positive control. Hepatic injury, inflammation, oxidative stress, apoptosis, JAK2/STAT3-associated NF-kappaB signaling, bile acid-related molecules, and ductular reaction markers were assessed. AG490-mediated pathway inhibition and IL-6-mediated STAT3 reactivation were performed to assess the functional involvement of STAT3 signaling. RESULTS: DHM improved cell viability and reduced TCA-induced ALT, AST, LDH, ALP, and inflammatory cytokine levels. Network pharmacology identified STAT3, AKT1, SRC, ESR1, and MMP9 as hub targets, while public transcriptomic and enrichment analyses highlighted inflammation-, apoptosis-, NF-kappaB-, and JAK/STAT-related pathways. DHM attenuated TCA-induced apoptosis and suppressed JAK2/STAT3-associated NF-kappaB activation, including reduced p65 nuclear translocation. DHM also regulated bile acid homeostasis-related molecules in vitro. In ANIT-treated mice, DHM improved liver histology, decreased ALT, AST, ALP, TBA, inflammatory cytokines, and oxidative stress, and suppressed hepatic apoptosis and JAK2/STAT3-NF-kappaB signaling. AG490 phenocopied the protective effects of DHM, whereas IL-6-mediated STAT3 reactivation partially weakened DHM-mediated protection. CONCLUSION: DHM alleviates CLI by suppressing inflammation, oxidative stress, and hepatocyte apoptosis, at least partly through inhibition of the JAK2/STAT3-NF-kappaB signaling axis.
abstract_zh: 背景：胆汁淤积性肝损伤（CLI）主要由肝脏胆汁酸蓄积驱动，促进肝细胞损伤、炎症、氧化应激和凋亡。二氢杨梅素（DHM），一种来自藤茶（Ampelopsis grossedentata）的生物活性黄酮类化合物，显示出肝保护潜力，但其在CLI中的作用和机制尚不清楚。方法：采用网络药理学、公共转录组分析和分子对接预测DHM在CLI中的候选靶点。分别使用牛磺胆酸（TCA）处理的HepaRG细胞和α-萘基异硫氰酸酯（ANIT）处理的小鼠作为体外和体内模型，并以熊去氧胆酸（UDCA）作为阳性对照。评估肝损伤、炎症、氧化应激、凋亡、JAK2/STAT3相关NF-kappaB信号、胆汁酸相关分子和导管反应标志物。通过AG490介导的途径抑制和IL-6介导的STAT3再激活来评估STAT3信号的功能参与。结果：DHM提高细胞活力，并降低TCA诱导的ALT、AST、LDH、ALP和炎症细胞因子水平。网络药理学鉴定STAT3、AKT1、SRC、ESR1和MMP9为核心靶点，而公共转录组和富集分析突出炎症、凋亡、NF-kappaB和JAK/STAT相关途径。DHM减弱TCA诱导的凋亡，并抑制JAK2/STAT3相关NF-kappaB激活，包括减少p65核转位。DHM在体外还调节胆汁酸稳态相关分子。在ANIT处理的小鼠中，DHM改善肝脏组织学，降低ALT、AST、ALP、TBA、炎症细胞因子和氧化应激，并抑制肝凋亡和JAK2/STAT3-NF-kappaB信号。AG490模拟了DHM的保护效应，而IL-6介导的STAT3再激活部分削弱了DHM介导的保护。结论：DHM通过抑制炎症、氧化应激和肝细胞凋亡减轻CLI，至少部分通过抑制JAK2/STAT3-NF-kappaB信号轴实现。
